title: Cokret Invite Receive Policy
description: Subject-private policy used by a Principal Server to decide which invite delivery introduction evidence may notify the holder. This policy is not written into the target Realm durable event log.

subject_id.description: Principal DID whose private invite receive policy this object configures. v1 core defaults principal DIDs to did:webvh; did:web is only valid for principal identity when an explicit deployment profile or resolver policy allows it.

allowed_introduction_kinds.description: Allowlist of introduction evidence kinds that may reach holder notification or review.

explicit_address_behavior.description: Default behavior for explicit_address evidence. Deployments SHOULD default to quarantine or drop, not notify.

unknown_invites.description: Behavior for delivery requests without compliant introduction_evidence.

blocked_subjects.description: Per-subject block list (peer principal DIDs). Invite delivery whose inviter is in this list MUST be dropped, and disclosure MUST be forced to opaque regardless of the disclosure policy, to avoid leaking the block via a side channel.

disclosure.description: Graded disclosure policy. Controls whether the invite delivery outcome reveals a real result (delivered/blocked/quarantined) to the inviter, by introduction trust tier. Omitted means the default: high_trust=outcome, low_trust=opaque.

disclosure_level.description: opaque: only a generic accepted-for-processing status is returned, indistinguishable across exists/not-exists/policy outcomes. outcome: the real delivered/blocked/quarantined result is disclosed to the inviter.

high_trust.description: Disclosure level for the high-trust introduction tier: consent_grant, locator_ref, shared_realm. Default outcome.

low_trust.description: Disclosure level for the low-trust introduction tier: same_principal_server, explicit_address, and missing/non-compliant evidence. Default opaque.
